subject: Safe generated-config reconciliation
statement: Runtime upgrade may automatically reconcile Python layout only when the current development config exactly matches a known unmodified generated Python preset. In that provable managed-default case it may re-render the same preset against current source roots; any customized or non-exact config remains untouched. This preserves consumer ownership while removing stale generated layout assumptions.
scope: bootstrap/config reconciliation, doctor/check ergonomics, tests, durable architecture decision

sourceSession.taskGoal: Reduce Agent DevTools integration friction for arbitrary Python execution environments by eliminating stale generated source-layout assumptions without weakening explicit project configuration
